currentViewers.description: Concurrent viewers at time of scrape (room-metadata mode only)
currentViewers.title: Current Viewers

eventTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime from TikTok's event createTime (event-stream mode, when available)
eventTimestamp.title: Event Timestamp

eventType.description: Event type for event-stream mode: 'chat', 'gift', 'like', 'follow', 'share', 'join', 'stats', or 'other'
eventType.title: Event Type

hostAvatarUrl.description: URL of the streamer's avatar image (room-metadata mode only)
hostAvatarUrl.title: Host Avatar URL

hostDisplayName.description: Display name of the streamer (room-metadata mode only)
hostDisplayName.title: Host Display Name

hostFollowerCount.description: Number of followers the streamer has (room-metadata mode only)
hostFollowerCount.title: Host Follower Count

hostFollowingCount.description: Number of accounts the streamer follows (room-metadata mode only)
hostFollowingCount.title: Host Following Count

hostUserId.description: TikTok user ID of the streamer (room-metadata mode only)
hostUserId.title: Host User ID

hostUsername.description: Username of the streamer (room-metadata mode only)
hostUsername.title: Host Username

hostVerified.description: Whether the streamer has a verified badge (room-metadata mode only)
hostVerified.title: Host Verified

liveRoomMode.description: TikTok internal room mode code (room-metadata mode only)
liveRoomMode.title: Live Room Mode

liveStatus.description: TikTok internal status code for the LIVE room (4 = active)
liveStatus.title: Live Status

liveTitle.description: Title of the LIVE stream (room-metadata mode only)
liveTitle.title: Live Title

liveUrl.description: URL to the LIVE stream page (room-metadata mode only)
liveUrl.title: Live URL

msgId.description: TikTok internal message ID for deduplication (event-stream mode, when available)
msgId.title: Message ID

payload.description: Event-type-specific data: text (chat), giftName/giftId/giftCount (gift), totalLikes (like), viewerCount/totalUsers (stats)
payload.title: Payload

receivedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime when the event was captured (event-stream mode)
receivedAt.title: Received At

roomId.description: TikTok LIVE room ID (string to preserve 64-bit precision)
roomId.title: Room ID

scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the data was collected
scrapedAt.title: Scraped At

startTime.description: Stream start time as a Unix timestamp (room-metadata mode only)
startTime.title: Start Time (Unix)

startedAt.description: Stream start time in ISO 8601 UTC format (room-metadata mode only)
startedAt.title: Started At

streamUrls.description: HLS and FLV playback URLs at multiple qualities (hls_ld, hls_sd, hls_hd, hls_hd_60, hls_uhd_60, flv_ld, flv_sd, flv_hd, etc.) — room-metadata mode only
streamUrls.title: Stream URLs

totalViewers.description: Cumulative unique viewers since stream started (room-metadata mode only)
totalViewers.title: Total Viewers

user.description: User who triggered the event (event-stream mode; absent for 'stats' and 'other' events)
user.title: User

overview.description: Room metadata rows (no sessionCookie) or real-time event rows (with sessionCookie). Room-metadata rows include stream URLs, viewer counts, and host profile. Event rows include chat messages, gifts, likes, joins, and viewer stats.
overview.title: LIVE Data Overview
